about: The compare read of the fixed 'Beware idealization' paragraphs (r27-ideal-b) beside the live post's, by one fresh reader (READER-1.md), 2026-11-08. Each finding's fate.

F1.1.why: 'that beauty' and the knight point back to the paragraph right before it (144: 'saw me as their knight in shining armor, and that brought out this divine-feminine beauty in them'), which the reader's part left out; in the article the antecedent is the sentence before.

F1.2.why: 'almost like a clinical diagnosis' already says it isn't one; the separate disclaimer was a caveat the needed read found the reader can lose, and Joel wants needless caveats cut from his articles. 'so much that' ties the prediction's strength to his use of it.

F1.3.why: severity 1: the quotes show the flip the way 147's quotes show the pedestal, and 'decides I was faking it all along' carries the live 'rewriting the whole past' (as the 2026-11-07 compare read already found for 148).

F1.4.why: it turned his boundary into a demand: 151's last sentence said again as his boundary, r27-ideal-c ('I’m not gonna act like they never cross my mind, not when I’m listening to everything on hers'), which read Human, High and Medium with no Low (#143).
